items.reason: It repeats the claim that a nil default_locale crashes fallback lookup when converted to a symbol. Adding an empty-value case and a normalization fix does not change the underlying claim.
It attributes repeated lookups or loading to mixed String and Symbol locales and proposes symbolizing the locale, matching the rejected normalization claim.
It identifies the same unsynchronized initialization and membership check of @loaded_locales inside ensure_loaded! and proposes protecting them with LOAD_MUTEX.
It repeats the claim that regex metacharacters in a user-controlled locale reach load_locale's Regexp and cause unintended locale files to load.
